## Final verdict

**PARTIAL** — 14 of 16 claims PASS; 2 FAIL (Claims 11 and 12).

The two FAILs are tightly coupled and have a single root cause: **three user-facing documents authored before the gate-2 inline correction were not updated to reflect the post-correction reality that per-cascaded-AR `auth_request.revoked` emission DOES ship in CH-14.**

Specifically:
- `m5_2/architecture/authority-chain.md:168` says per-AR emission "is deferred (drift `D-CH14-FOLLOWUP-02`)".
- `m5_2/operations/authority-chain-operations.md:18` says "Per-cascaded-AR `auth_request.revoked` events are NOT emitted at CH-14 (deferred per ADR-0053 §D53.7 + drift `D-CH14-FOLLOWUP-02`)".
- `m1/architecture/audit-events.md:1` (CH-14 amendment line) says "Per-cascaded-AR `auth_request.revoked` events are NOT emitted at CH-14 (deferred per ADR-0053 §D53.7 + drift `D-CH14-FOLLOWUP-02`)" + does not document the new per-cascaded-AR emission cardinality change that the plan §7 P3 deliverable 8 explicitly asked for.

These three documents directly contradict (a) ADR-0053 §D53.7 (which says emission ships), (b) the shipped code at `server/src/platform/templates/revoke.rs:114-136` (which iterates `cascade.cascaded_ars` and emits per AR), (c) the FOLLOWUP-02 drift Status = remediated, and (d) the audit-matrix row 233 cell which credits `D-CH14-FOLLOWUP-02 ✓`.

The contradiction is self-detected by the cycle-index header amendment (line 1) which acknowledges the gate-2 inline correction shipped per-AR emission, but the three documents were not patched downstream of the correction.

This is a **Trivial-multi**-tier FAIL (per `CLAUDE.md` Multi-agent chunk pipeline §"Audit-fix loop"): the patches are surgical (rewrite three short paragraphs / amendment lines) but exceed the 1-line orchestrator-applied threshold, so a chunk-implementer re-spawn for inline correction (or an orchestrator-applied multi-line patch with its own cycle-audit row) is the appropriate remediation path. No new architectural finding; no scope drift; no new drift to file (the existing FOLLOWUP-02 drift is already correctly remediated — only the docs need to catch up).

All 4 CI guards green, workspace tests at 1431 (matches gate-2 expected post-correction band), 14/16 PASS claims with concrete file:line evidence chains, no unauthorised concept-doc body changes detected. Recommend re-spawn implementer for trivial-multi doc-sync fix; no need to re-spawn planner (the planner-side specification is internally consistent — only the implementation-side docs are stale).
